doc: control-room/06 Findings/Q1-2 Frequency vs depth.md
quote: **Portugal is not Spain in 2025.** Spain had 556 negative hours, Portugal 200. Most of the gap is May 2025: Spain 239 negative hours, Portugal 4, and the two hourly prices differed in 389 hours that month, against 2 to 136 hours in every other month of 2025 (hourly means). This follows the 28 April 2025 Iberian blackout: trading between the two countries was halted, then Portugal's grid operator REN capped imports from Spain and eased the cap in steps (1,500 MW between 9:00 and 20:00 on 19 to 26 May, per REN as reported by [Bloomberg, 18 May 2025](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-05-18/portugal-eases-limits-on-power-imports-from-spain-after-blackout)). With the interconnector limited, Spain's midday surplus could not reach Portugal. Treat "Iberia" as one block for 2025 only with this caveat.
